_about: Shared by BOTH languages. tests/a29-deposit-and-rounding.test.mjs runs every row against supabase/functions/_shared/quote-deposit.ts; app/src/test/java/com/fenceestimator/app/estimate/JobMoneyDepositRuleTest.kt runs the same rows against EstimateEngine.roundToCents and JobMoney.ruleDeposit / depositSuggestion. Change a row and both must agree, or one goes red. Every expected value was worked out by hand from the owner's rules of 1 Oct 2026, not copied from either implementation.
_rules: A total is exact to the cent: Math.round(x * 100) / 100, halves toward +infinity (roundToCents).
The deposit is the materials still to be bought (net of money already in), rounded UP to the next $100, plus another $100, and never more than is still owed on the job.
A figure that is already a whole hundred stays there before the $100 is added: $1,000 of materials is a $1,100 deposit.

roundToCents.name: float dust above a clean total
float dust below a clean total
a sum that landed a hair high
an exact half cent rounds up
a double just under a half cent stays down (1.005 is really 1.00499999999999989)
a negative credit keeps its sign
